evidence.notes: Database.UnitOfWork queues local DML, supports discardWork, and applies queued records on commitWork.
Alias evidence kept for the docs-side System.Database identity row.

source.content: @isTest private class DatabaseUnitOfWorkEvidenceTest { @isTest static void unitOfWorkQueuesAndCommitsRows() { Database.UnitOfWork discarded = new Database.UnitOfWork(); discarded.insertRecord(new Account(Name = 'Discarded')); discarded.discardWork(); discarded.commitWork(); System.assertEquals(0, ((List<Account>)Database.query('SELECT Id FROM Account')).size()); Database.UnitOfWork work = new Database.UnitOfWork(); Database.SaveResult insertResult = work.insertRecord(new Account(Name = 'Queued')); System.assertEquals(false, insertResult.isSuccess()); System.assertEquals(0, ((List<Account>)Database.query('SELECT Id FROM Account')).size()); work.commitWork(); System.assertEquals(true, insertResult.isSuccess()); System.assertNotEquals(null, insertResult.getId()); System.assertEquals(1, ((List<Account>)Database.query('SELECT Id FROM Account')).size()); Database.UnitOfWork bulk = new Database.UnitOfWork(); List<Account> accounts = new List<Account>{new Account(Name = 'Bulk One'), new Account(Name = 'Bulk Two')}; List<Database.SaveResult> results = bulk.insertRecords(accounts); bulk.commitWork(); System.assertEquals(2, results.size()); System.assertEquals(true, results[0].isSuccess()); System.assertEquals(true, results[1].isSuccess()); Account single = [SELECT Id, Name FROM Account WHERE Name = 'Queued']; single.Name = 'Updated One'; Database.UnitOfWork updates = new Database.UnitOfWork(); Database.SaveResult updateResult = updates.updateRecord(single); updates.commitWork(); System.assertEquals(true, updateResult.isSuccess()); System.assertEquals('Updated One', ((Account)Database.query('SELECT Id, Name FROM Account WHERE Id = :single.Id')[0]).Name); Account upsertSingle = new Account(Name = 'Upsert Single'); Database.UnitOfWork upserts = new Database.UnitOfWork(); Database.UpsertResult upsertResult = upserts.upsertRecord(upsertSingle); List<Account> upsertMany = new List<Account>{new Account(Name = 'Upsert Many One'), new Account(Name = 'Upsert Many Two')}; List<Database.UpsertResult> upsertResults = upserts.upsertRecords(upsertMany); upserts.commitWork(); System.assertEquals(true, upsertResult.isSuccess()); System.assertEquals(2, upsertResults.size()); System.assertEquals(true, upsertResults[0].isSuccess()); List<Account> many = [SELECT Id, Name FROM Account WHERE Name LIKE 'Upsert Many%']; many[0].Name = 'Updated Many One'; many[1].Name = 'Updated Many Two'; Database.UnitOfWork listUpdates = new Database.UnitOfWork(); List<Database.SaveResult> updateResults = listUpdates.updateRecords(many); listUpdates.commitWork(); System.assertEquals(2, updateResults.size()); System.assertEquals(true, updateResults[0].isSuccess()); Database.UnitOfWork deletes = new Database.UnitOfWork(); Database.DeleteResult deleteResult = deletes.deleteRecord(upsertSingle); List<Database.DeleteResult> deleteResults = deletes.deleteRecords(many); deletes.commitWork(); System.assertEquals(true, deleteResult.isSuccess()); System.assertEquals(2, deleteResults.size()); System.assertEquals(true, deleteResults[0].isSuccess()); } }
